Coverage: legal terms/privacy (version+effective+content>1000 chars), T&C-gated register (missing/mismatched rejected with 400; matching succeeds and returns role='user'), admin login (dhruvpateld230@gmail.com/strongpass123 -> role='admin'), admin overview with all numeric stats, admin users list with email_masked and NO raw email/password_hash, non-admin token blocked with 403 across 6 admin endpoints, suspend->403 login->reactivate->200 login flow, self-serve password reset (forgot returns {status:'sent'}, DB has OTP, reset+new-password login works, old password no longer valid), invalid OTP returns 400, expired OTP (inserted with past expires_at) returns 400 with 'expired' message, support ticket end-to-end (create->my tickets->admin masked email->admin resolve->user sees resolved), report lifecycle (create->admin list open->resolve->admin list resolved), watchlist add+hydrated list with overall_health_score+delete, better-for-you alternatives (Steel-Cut oats 8901030895002 present with higher overall_health_score than seeded Rolled oats 8901030895001), multi-country /api/plans for US/USD/stripe, IN/INR/razorpay, NZ/NZD/stripe, admin /api/admin/pricing lists all 8 seeded countries (IN,US,CA,EU,GB,AE,AU,NZ) and PUT /api/admin/pricing/US persists and is reflected in public /api/plans?country=US, admin promocode create WELCOME20 percent 20 -> public /api/promocodes/WELCOME20 returns it -> DELETE marks inactive -> public lookup returns 404. Email masking helper verified on both /admin/users and /admin/support responses. OCR endpoint and Stripe checkout intentionally skipped per request.
action_items: Iteration-4 backend surface is stable. Prior iteration_3 findings (personalized_match bug on fragranced product, remote_lookup blocking event loop with sync requests, consume_scan decrementing before 404 product check, Stripe webhook trusting client metadata, server.py at ~1040 lines) still apply and should be addressed in Iteration 5. Note: server.py has now grown past the 700-line split threshold — recommend extracting admin routes, payments, and OCR helper into separate modules.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1040 lines — well above the 700-line guideline. Split into auth/admin/products/payments/ocr modules.
remote_lookup still uses sync requests inside an async FastAPI handler; migrate to httpx.AsyncClient to avoid event-loop blocking.
consume_scan is called BEFORE the DB/remote product resolution in some paths, so 404 lookups still burn a guest quota (already reported in iter3).
admin_promocode_create catches all exceptions to return 409, masking real errors (e.g. validation issues). Narrow to DuplicateKeyError only.
AdminPricingUpdate model repeats the country field even though the path already carries it; the implementation overwrites the payload's country from the URL, which is safe but redundant.
seed_data_creation: Transient TEST users, one WELCOME20 promocode (created & cleaned up after test), and OTP rows in db.password_resets from forgot-password and one manually-inserted expired OTP. All promocode state cleaned; users left in place (no cleanup requirement — emails are unique per run via uuid).
